schedule: before 5am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates once every CI check on the branch has passed. Renovate merges itself (platformAutomerge=false) because main has no required status checks, so GitHub native auto-merge would not wait for CI.
Major updates always need a manual review.
cyclopts>=4 makes App.__call__ always sys.exit() (breaks CLI tests); cyclopts>=5 requires Python>=3.11. Keep in sync with pyproject.toml.
